critical_notes: General-state reversible-kernel, ergodicity, and MCMC CLT suppliers are missing locally; countable-state results must not be generalized without proof.
HMC/MALA invariance is exact only with the appropriate MH correction when numerical proposals are used; constant-step ULA has invariant law pi_gamma, generally not the target pi.
Diminishing adaptation alone is insufficient. The cited adaptive-MCMC theorems need simultaneous uniform ergodicity or a containment condition, and provide no general adaptive CLT.
MCMC diagnostics are screening tools and can be fooled by shared chain bias or thinning.
